column1: # Expected mismatches of the backend isolation matrix (tests/isolation/conformance.rs
# --expected), measured in the pinned root where validate runs. Tab-separated:
# A selector root:path:policy (with * for any) names cells that collect no guest
# observations (verdict `uncollected`). Any other selector names an assertion family
# (digits written N), optionally @root:path:policy, that may be mismatch and/or
# no_result in a collected cell; `match` added means it matches where the host hides
# the defect. The matrix fails on any non-match no row expects, and on any row that
# no longer describes a failure on a backend it names: fix the issue, then delete the
# backend from its row. Regenerate by measuring; never widen a row to make a run pass.
